name: ding
description: Create persistent watches, review changes, and understand alerts from your own Ding instance.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent watches. Evidence behind every alert.
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Ding instance. Create watches from a conversation, inspect the exact changes before applying them, and investigate events with their recorded evidence. Ding keeps monitoring independently of the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Show my watches that need attention.
Help me create a health check watch.
